أتقايض (form VI)
# أَتَقَايَضُ (ʔataqāyaḍu) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ja.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# أَتَقَايَضَ (ʔataqāyaḍa) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ja.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
# أَتَقَايَضْ (ʔataqāyaḍ) /ʔa.ta.qaː.jadˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَقَايَضَ (taqāyaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
